acceptance: Red test first: while the bridge runs the in-wait builder self-check floor (workflow.builder_selfcheck.stage enforce), the liveness observer records the floor as progress and emits no LIVENESS_PHASE_STALLED; a floor that exceeds its deadline still ends as today (WARN, today's closeout).
A pane that is truly idle with no floor running still raises the stall.
Docs in STE: the liveness and bridge package notes record the rule.
fix: Wave 149, cycles 2111 and 2112: the build turn finished, the bridge ran the enforced self-check floor inside the pane wait (it also waits on the host verification lock behind other lanes), and the pane-watch file stopped updating, so the observer raised LIVENESS_PHASE_STALLED after 10 minutes although the cycle was progressing. Mark the in-wait floor as progress (update the pane-watch progress, or record a typed 'self-check running' state the liveness reader honours).
notes: Console route: bridge wait loop and liveness. Follow-up of PR #1236 (builder self-check at enforce).
summary: The enforced self-check runs the floor inside the pane wait without touching the progress record, so every self-checked build raises a false stall alarm after 10 minutes.
title: The in-wait self-check floor counts as liveness progress
